title: 响应式 UI 模式
html:
响应式 UI 模式

响应式编程在 UI 层解决了经典的"状态同步噩梦"——多处代码修改同一个视图状态，导致竞态条件和不一致。通过将 UI 状态建模为响应式流，视图成为状态的纯函数映射，消除了手动同步的根源。

核心概念

UI 响应式化的两个基础模式：

MVVM + 响应式绑定：
  View ←(绑定)← ViewModel(Observable<State>) ←(转换)← Model(Repository/Service)
  View ——(用户事件)→ ViewModel.intent(Observable<Action>)

单向数据流（Unidirectional Data Flow, UDF）：
  Action → Reducer/Store → State → View → Action → ...
  （循环，但单向）
graph LR
    View -->|用户事件| ViewModel
    ViewModel -->|StateFlow/Observable| View
    ViewModel -->|调用| Repository
    Repository -->|Flow/Observable| ViewModel

    subgraph 单向数据流
    A[Action] --> R[Reducer]
    R --> S[State]
    S --> V[View]
    V --> A
    end
模式 框架 状态持有 UI 更新触发
MVVM + RxJS Angular Observable<T> async 管道
MVVM + Combine SwiftUI @Published / StateFlow 自动重渲染
MVVM + Flow Android Jetpack Compose StateFlow collectAsState()
Redux React RxJS Store useSelector

Angular + RxJS：声明式组件

// Angular 响应式表单 + HTTP 防抖搜索
@Component({
  selector: 'app-search',
  template: `
    <input [formControl]="searchControl" />
    <!-- async 管道自动订阅和取消 -->
    <div *ngFor="let item of results$ | async">{{ item.name }}</div>
    <div *ngIf="loading$ | async">加载中...</div>
    <div *ngIf="error$ | async as err">{{ err }}</div>
  `,
})
export class SearchComponent implements OnInit {
  searchControl = new FormControl('');
  results$!: Observable<SearchResult[]>;
  loading$!: Observable<boolean>;
  error$!: Observable<string | null>;

  constructor(private searchService: SearchService) {}

  ngOnInit() {
    const search$ = this.searchControl.valueChanges.pipe(
      debounceTime(300),
      distinctUntilChanged(),
      filter((q) => (q?.length ?? 0) >= 2),
      shareReplay(1),
    );

    // 使用 startWith/merge 派生 loading/error 状态
    const searchResult$ = search$.pipe(
      switchMap((q) =>
        this.searchService.search(q!).pipe(
          map((data) => ({ data, error: null, loading: false })),
          startWith({ data: null, error: null, loading: true }),
          catchError((e) => of({ data: null, error: e.message, loading: false })),
        ),
      ),
      shareReplay(1),
    );

    this.results$ = searchResult$.pipe(
      map((state) => state.data ?? []),
      startWith([]),
    );
    this.loading$ = searchResult$.pipe(map((state) => state.loading));
    this.error$ = searchResult$.pipe(map((state) => state.error));
  }
}

SwiftUI + Combine：声明式状态绑定

import SwiftUI
import Combine

// ViewModel 作为状态容器
@MainActor
class TodoViewModel: ObservableObject {
    @Published private(set) var todos: [Todo] = []
    @Published private(set) var isLoading = false
    @Published private(set) var errorMessage: String? = nil

    private let todoRepository: TodoRepository
    private var cancellables = Set<AnyCancellable>()

    init(repository: TodoRepository) {
        self.todoRepository = repository
        loadTodos()
    }

    func loadTodos() {
        isLoading = true
        errorMessage = nil

        todoRepository.fetchAll()
            .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)
            .sink(
                receiveCompletion: { [weak self] completion in
                    self?.isLoading = false
                    if case .failure(let err) = completion {
                        self?.errorMessage = err.localizedDescription
                    }
                },
                receiveValue: { [weak self] todos in
                    self?.todos = todos
                }
            )
            .store(in: &cancellables)
    }

    func toggle(_ todo: Todo) {
        // 乐观更新：先修改本地状态，再同步到服务器
        if let idx = todos.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == todo.id }) {
            todos[idx].isCompleted.toggle()
        }

        todoRepository.update(todo.toggled())
            .catch { [weak self] _ in
                // 同步失败时回滚
                self?.loadTodos()
                return Empty<Void, Never>()
            }
            .sink(receiveValue: { })
            .store(in: &cancellables)
    }
}

// View 是状态的纯函数
struct TodoView: View {
    @StateObject private var vm = TodoViewModel(repository: .live)

    var body: some View {
        List(vm.todos) { todo in
            HStack {
                Image(systemName: todo.isCompleted ? "checkmark.circle" : "circle")
                Text(todo.title)
            }
            .onTapGesture { vm.toggle(todo) }
        }
        .overlay {
            if vm.isLoading { ProgressView() }
        }
        .alert("错误", isPresented: .constant(vm.errorMessage != nil)) {
            Button("重试") { vm.loadTodos() }
        } message: {
            Text(vm.errorMessage ?? "")
        }
    }
}

Android Jetpack Compose + StateFlow

// ViewModel 持有 StateFlow
@HiltViewModel
class ArticleListViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repo: ArticleRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    // 单一 UI 状态对象（避免多个 StateFlow 不一致）
    data class UiState(
        val articles: List<Article> = emptyList(),
        val isLoading: Boolean = false,
        val error: String? = null
    )

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(UiState(isLoading = true))
    val uiState: StateFlow<UiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    // 一次性事件用 SharedFlow（导航、Toast 等）
    private val _events = MutableSharedFlow<UiEvent>()
    val events = _events.asSharedFlow()

    init {
        loadArticles()
    }

    private fun loadArticles() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            repo.getAll()
                .onStart  { _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = true) } }
                .catch    { e -> _uiState.update { it.copy(error = e.message, isLoading = false) } }
                .collect  { articles ->
                    _uiState.update { it.copy(articles = articles, isLoading = false) }
                }
        }
    }

    fun refresh() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = true) }
            loadArticles()
        }
    }
}

// Compose UI
@Composable
fun ArticleListScreen(vm: ArticleListViewModel = hiltViewModel()) {
    val uiState by vm.uiState.collectAsState()

    Box {
        when {
            uiState.isLoading  -> CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.align(Alignment.Center))
            uiState.error != null -> ErrorView(uiState.error!!, onRetry = vm::refresh)
            else -> LazyColumn {
                items(uiState.articles) { ArticleItem(it) }
            }
        }
    }
}

单向数据流的设计原则

// 原则1: ViewModel 不持有 View 的引用，只暴露 Observable<State>
class ViewModelGood {
  // ✅ 只暴露可观察状态
  readonly state$: Observable<State> = this.store.state$;
  // ✅ 接受 Action（输入）
  dispatch(action: Action) {
    this.store.dispatch(action);
  }
}

// 原则2: 区分 State（持久展示）和 Event（一次性）
class ViewModel {
  readonly state$: Observable<UiState>; // 可以重复读取
  readonly events$: Observable<UiEvent>; // SharedFlow，只消费一次
  //       ↑ 用于：导航、弹 Toast、显示 Dialog
}

// 原则3: 避免在 View 层做业务逻辑
// ❌ 不好
template: `{{ (user$ | async)?.name | titlecase }}`; // 格式化属于 ViewModel
// ✅ 好
template: `{{ displayName$ | async }}`; // ViewModel 已格式化好

小结

  • MVVM + 响应式绑定让 View 成为状态的纯函数：state → view，消除手动 UI 同步
  • async 管道（Angular）/ collectAsState()（Compose）/ @Published（SwiftUI）自动管理订阅生命周期
  • StateFlow（Kotlin）/ @Published（Swift）/ BehaviorSubject（RxJS）承担"当前状态"语义；SharedFlow / PassthroughSubject 承担"一次性事件"语义
  • 设计原则：状态与事件分离、ViewModel 不引用 View、View 层不做业务逻辑
